```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(profvis)
library(knitr)
library(smacof)
library(rgl)
library(reticulate)
library(microbenchmark)
options(rgl.useNULL = TRUE)
rgl::setupKnitr(autoprint = TRUE)
knit_hooks$set(webgl = hook_webgl)

# Import all code for STPCA
setwd("../R")
mds_sources <- list.files()
sapply(mds_sources, source)
```

```{r}
# Steve's example, small circles on S^2 x S^2
data <- read.table(file = "../data/TorusToyEg.txt", header = FALSE)
data <- as.matrix(data, ncol = 6)
n <- nrow(data)
mfrow3d(nr = 1, nc = 2, sharedMouse = TRUE)
dims <- c(2, 2)
plot3d(data[, 4:6],
  col = rainbow(n), xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1),
  zlim = c(-1, 1)
)
plot3d(data[, 1:3],
  col = rainbow(n), xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1),
  zlim = c(-1, 1)
)

data <- normalize_poly(data, dims)
angular <- FALSE
landmark_size <- .1
tol <- 5e-3
landmark_tol <- 5e-4

time <- Sys.time()
p_curve <- plot_mds(x = data, dims = dims, landmark_size = landmark_size, angular = angular, tol = tol, landmark_tol = landmark_tol, gradient = TRUE)
print(Sys.time() - time)
```

```{r}
close3d()
mfrow3d(nr = 1, nc = 1, sharedMouse = TRUE)
plot3d(p_curve$mds_data[, 1:3], col = rainbow(n))
```

```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache = TRUE)
close3d()
mfrow3d(nr = 1, nc = 2, sharedMouse = TRUE)
res <- inverse_mds(x = data, result = p_curve, grid_size = 100, dims = dims, angular = FALSE, method = "NW", plot = TRUE)
plot3d(rbind(data[, 4:6], res[, 4:6]),
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", col = c(rainbow(n), rep("black", 100)), pch = 16
)
```

```{r, echo=TRUE,results='hide',fig.keep='all'}
# Clusters on S^2
set.seed(100)
n <- 210
d <- 3
k <- 100
nspheres <- 1
cluster1 <- rotasym::r_vMF(n / 3, c(rotasym::r_unif_sphere(1, 3)), k)
cluster2 <- rotasym::r_vMF(n / 3, c(rotasym::r_unif_sphere(1, 3)), k)
cluster3 <- rotasym::r_vMF(n / 3, c(rotasym::r_unif_sphere(1, 3)), k)
clusters <- rbind(cluster1, cluster2, cluster3)
col1 <- rep("#009999", (n / 3))
col2 <- rep("#FF0033", (n / 3))
col3 <- rep("#66FF00", (n / 3))
col <- c(col1, col2, col3)
close3d()
plot3d(clusters[, 1:3], col = col, xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1))

dims <- rep(2, nspheres)
angular <- FALSE
landmark_size <- .1
tol <- 5e-3
landmark_tol <- 5e-4

time <- Sys.time()
p_curve <- plot_mds(x = clusters, dims = dims, landmark_size = landmark_size, angular = angular, tol = tol, landmark_tol = landmark_tol, col = col, gradient = TRUE)
print(Sys.time() - time)
```

```{r}
close3d()
mfrow3d(nr = 1, nc = 1, sharedMouse = TRUE)
sc <- march_PNS1_shapes(seq(0, p_curve$pns_info$radii[sum(dims)] * 2 * pi, l = 100),
  PNS = p_curve$pns_info
)
plot3d(rbind(p_curve$mds_data, sc), col = c(col, rep("black", 100)), xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1))
```

set.seed(100)

d <- 3
k <- 100
nspheres <- 2
cluster1 <- rotasym::r_vMF(n / 3, c(rotasym::r_unif_sphere(1, 3)), k)

```{r, echo=TRUE,results='hide',fig.keep='all'}
# Clusters on S^2, band on S^2
set.seed(100)
n <- 210
d <- 3
k <- 100
nspheres <- 2
cluster1 <- rotasym::r_vMF(n / 3, c(rotasym::r_unif_sphere(1, 3)), k)
cluster2 <- rotasym::r_vMF(n / 3, c(rotasym::r_unif_sphere(1, 3)), k)
cluster3 <- rotasym::r_vMF(n / 3, c(rotasym::r_unif_sphere(1, 3)), k)
clusters <- rbind(cluster1, cluster2, cluster3)
clusters <- cbind(clusters,r_path_s2r(n = n, r = 1, sigma = 0.10)[, , 1])

col1 <- rep("#009999", (n / 3))
col2 <- rep("#FF0033", (n / 3))
col3 <- rep("#66FF00", (n / 3))
col <- c(col1, col2, col3)

close3d()
mfrow3d(nr = 1, nc = 2, sharedMouse = TRUE)
plot3d(
  clusters[, 1:3],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", col = col, pch = 16
)
plot3d(
  clusters[, 4:6],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", col = col, pch = 16
)

dims <- rep(2, nspheres)
angular <- FALSE
landmark_size <- .1
tol <- 5e-3
landmark_tol <- 5e-4

time <- Sys.time()
p_curve <- plot_mds(x = clusters, dims = dims, landmark_size = landmark_size, angular = angular, tol = tol, landmark_tol = landmark_tol, col = col, gradient = TRUE)
print(Sys.time() - time)
```
